sonnet.problem: The fill-in-the-blank asks the baker to supply the last word of the verse 4 line ('but the ___ remains forever'). Card 5 only says generations come and go. It gives nothing that points to 'earth' over 'temple' or 'city', so the baker can only guess the wording and can't reason it out.
sonnet.rule: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
